people.imagined: At the forge at the close of the day, wiping his hands on a rag and lifting the left one to look at the stubs of his missing fingers, as he does when the war comes up at the long table. He is about to say it again.
people.subject: The moment: at the end of a forge day, a smith holds up his LEFT hand toward the viewer, palm out, to show it: the last two fingers (ring and little finger) are missing, only smooth stumps remain, and the three left fingers are spread. Face: a square, heavy, soot-darkened face; deep lines; small steady grey eyes; heavy straight brows singed short; a flat nose; a thick moustache; a stubborn, patient, closed mouth. Hair: short grey-black, cropped close, with a sweat band of folded cloth round the forehead. Body: broad and thick through the chest and shoulders, huge forearms, a short neck. Clothing: a thick brown leather apron with a scorched hem over a dark-brown tunic with crossed collar, sleeves cut off above the elbow and strapped with leather vambraces; a sand-coloured cloak hung at the shoulder; a small horn whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: the raised left hand with its missing fingers is the focus; his right hand holds a long iron striker's hammer resting on his shoulder. A well-made narrow straight sword of his own forging, its grip bound in sand-brown leather with the thumb-groove cut deeper on the left for his shortened hand, a squared guard of dark iron with a small hammer-mark stamped in it, a scabbard of dark-brown cowhide stitched with sinew and scorched at the throat is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the left shoulder. Background: blurred dark forge, a glow of coals, a bellows. Light: red-orange firelight from the lower left, a hint of heavy ochre earth qi at the hammer. Expression: a tired, stubborn face with deep lines about the eyes and a heavy, resolved mouth just opening to speak.

people.imagined: On a stone stair in the evening, counting steps under his breath, his lips moving. He is also counting the people on the stair behind him, and he is not sure how many he is missing.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a stone stair he looks back over his shoulder at the viewer with his lips moving as if counting, one forefinger lifted and tapping the air. Face: a lean, careful, tan face with a long jaw; pale grey eyes slightly narrowed; fine level brows; a long straight nose; thin lips shaped around a silent count; a few early lines at the eyes. Hair: dark brown, tied back at the nape in a tight tail, neat. Body: tall, lean, upright, a lieutenant's tidy bearing. Clothing: a sand-coloured dust cloak, clean and well hung, pinned at the right shoulder so the sabre hilt shows at the left hip; a dark brown tunic with a crossed collar; leather vambraces; a flat dark sash. Hands and objects: the forefinger of the right hand raised mid-count; the left hand rests on the grip of a sheathed sabre; a small bone whistle on a cord at his collar. Background: blurred sandstone steps in blue dusk, a lamp lit in an arch. Light: cool blue dusk from the upper left, a touch of warm lamp at his cheek, a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: cautious, honest, and quietly uncertain; the look of a man who has chosen the easy name before.

people.imagined: At the forge, arms aching from the bellows, she has just been told again that she may not do the quench. She swipes sweat off her face and demands the next strike, glaring at the apprentice.
people.subject: The moment: at a forge she is gripping the long bellows handle with both hands, leaning back on it, her chin out, glaring at someone off to the right. Face (most important: the eyebrows): a round, flushed, soot-streaked young face; there are NO real eyebrows, only a band of short dark stubble where they were shaved, and the left stubble line is nicked with a notch that tilts it into a permanent question; bright, hard, dark eyes; a short nose; a stubborn pressed mouth. Sweat cuts clean lines through the soot at her temples. Hair: black, in a thick single braid wound round the head, held with a leather thong. Body: strong, short, sturdy arms with visible muscle, bent forward. Clothing: a thick leather smith's apron over a plain brown tunic with a crossed collar, sleeves pushed past the elbows; scorched leather wrist wraps; a small horn whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: both hands on a long wooden bellows handle; a pair of tongs hanging at her belt. The bellows handle is polished dark by years of hands and a small ring of orange glows on her knuckles. Background: blurred forge, a white-hot glow, hanging tools. Light: fierce orange light from the front left, a hint of ember fire qi at her cheek. Expression: an impatient, jut-chinned glare with the brows' question mark cocked, a girl who has been told no again and means to be told yes.

people.imagined: Night watch on the Đà Linh road. A rider passes on the far side and he does not turn his head, although his eyes follow her. His nose has been broken twice and set once.
people.subject: The moment: on a night road by a small fire, he keeps his head dead straight but slides his eyes to the right as if watching a passer-by he refuses to acknowledge. Face (most important: the nose): a hard young face, weathered; his nose is clearly broken, bent sharply to the left with a bump on the bridge and a second kink below it, the crooked nose dominating the face; dark flat eyes; heavy brows; a firm hard mouth; a faint scar across one cheek. Hair: black, short, roughly shorn, with a night-watch rag of dark cloth tied round the head. Body: stocky, broad, standing square. Clothing: a sand-coloured dust cloak with a hood thrown back, over a dark-brown quilted tunic with crossed collar; leather vambraces; a sabre on the left hip; a horn whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: his left hand holds a short iron lantern shuttered to a slit of light; his right rests on the sabre pommel. Background: blurred dark desert road, a camel, a few stars. Light: a low firelight orange from the lower right and cold starlight from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a stone-set face with a rigid jaw, the head dead straight and only the eyes sliding sideways.

people.imagined: In the watch-house at dawn she sits with the watch book open and chews a pen end, a fresh one tucked behind each ear. She is deciding, on a whim, whose name to strike. She has already decided.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk at dawn she looks up suddenly from a ledger with a pen between her teeth, eyes sharp and suspicious. Face (most important: the pens): a sharp, narrow, sallow face; wary dark eyes with dark shadows beneath; thin straight brows; a small nose; her mouth clamped on a chewed pen end; she has several chewed pen-ends, at least three, tucked behind EACH ear, standing out like quills, clearly visible. Her lower lip is stained faintly blue from the pen. Hair: black, short and uneven, cut with a knife, pushed behind both ears. Body: thin, angular, hunched over the desk. Clothing: a sand-coloured dust cloak thrown over a dark-brown tunic with crossed collar, sleeves with ink-stained cuffs; leather vambraces; a horn whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: a thick open book showing only horizontal rows of dots and hoofprint sketches, no letters; her right hand clutches a brush hovering over it; a hoofprint cast in plaster on the desk. Past the right shoulder rises the tan-corded hilt of a plain long straight sword slung on the back, its ochre-brown scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of plain grey steel. Background: blurred watch-house wall, a dusty window with grey dawn. A sand-grey window lets in the first light and a small brass lamp is burning out on the sill. Light: cold grey dawn from the upper left, a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a sharp, narrow, suspicious stare with the mouth clamped on the pen, a foundling who trusts nobody's tea and has already struck a name.

people.imagined: In the long hall with a feather duster at the cup shelf, he has stopped on the eleventh recent cup and is turning it in his hands, frowning, as the thought has just landed.
people.subject: The moment: in a long hall he stands on a stool before a high shelf lined with rows of pale glass and jade cups, holding one cup up to the light in both hands, frowning. Face: a pleasant, open, round young face; wide-set honest brown eyes with a crease between the brows; a pale, earnest mouth slightly open; a small nose; a little fuzz on the lip. A scatter of freckles shows across his nose. Hair: black, short, flopping onto the forehead. Body: slender, a bit gangly, tall on the stool. Clothing: a clean sand-coloured dust cloak, folded back off the shoulders so it does not brush the shelf; dark-brown tunic with crossed collar; sleeves tied back with cords. Hands and objects: the fingertips of both hands are visibly wax-yellow; one night-glowing cup, pale green glass, held up and glowing faintly; a feather duster tucked in his belt; behind him, rows of identical small cups. Background: blurred shelves of many small cups going up into shadow, a long table. Light: warm hall light from the upper left, a soft green glow from the cup; a faint ochre earth qi hint. A pale green gleam from the cup falls across his chin and fingers. Expression: an earnest, open, slightly puzzled frown, lips parted, the look of a trusting boy who has just begun to doubt something small and very important.

people.imagined: The end of the evening in the long hall kitchen. She sets down one extra bowl, at an empty seat, as she does every night, and no one has told her to. Her palms are white with old salt scars.
people.subject: The moment: in a long hall by lamplight she sets a bowl of steaming food at an empty place at the table and turns her open palms up toward the viewer, as if showing she has nothing more to give. Face: a soft, round, kind face; large, gentle brown eyes; thick soft brows; a small nose; a calm, shy smile; flushed cheeks. Hair: black, in a long braid pinned up in a loop, a scrap of white cloth tied over it. A few loose curls have escaped the cloth and stick to her damp temples from the heat of the stove. Body: short and sturdy, round shoulders, a cook's strong forearms. She stands with her feet together and her elbows tucked, a cook's economical stance. Clothing: a sand-coloured shawl over a plain, clean dark-brown tunic with crossed collar; an apron of undyed cotton, sleeves rolled. Both palms, held up, are covered with pale white scars like cracked salt, crisscrossing, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a steaming bowl of rice and mutton beside an empty chair with no one at it; a ladle. Background: blurred long hall, benches, lamps. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, steam catching the light. Steam from the bowl blurs the lower edge of her chin and the flame of a lamp is reflected in the dark of her eyes. Expression: a soft, quiet, devout face with gentle lowered eyes and a calm, tender mouth.

people.imagined: In the long hall, seated with her back to the wall, as in every room. Above her head the shelf of 312 cups glimmers. She has just counted the doors again and her eyes settle on the one the viewer comes through.
people.subject: The moment: she sits with her back against a plain stone wall, a sabre across her knees, and her eyes have just turned to the doorway where the viewer enters. Face: a square, strong, sun-darkened face, like tanned leather; broad cheekbones; hard black eyes with fine lines round them; level strong brows; a straight nose; a thin, firm mouth; a faint scar at the left jaw. Hair: black with a few grey threads, pulled back and pinned in a tight low knot. Body: square and compact, broad shoulders, the posture of someone who sits with a wall at her back. Clothing: a sand-coloured dust cloak of fine heavy wool, clean and sharply hung, over a dark-brown tunic with crossed collar and buckled leather vambraces; a horn whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: across her knees a broad sabre with a grey horn hilt in a plain dark sheath; her left hand rests on a small round shield faced with dull iron leaning at her side. Background: above and behind her, a blurred shelf packed with rows of small pale cups gleaming. Light: warm low hall light from the upper left; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a watchful, narrowed gaze with a tight, still mouth and a steady fixed stare on the viewer, tensed for the door.

people.imagined: Spring quenching day at Tẩy Kiếm Tuyền. A blade is in the water and he is entirely silent. His hand is on the hammer and his eyes on the steam. He is thinking that it is one blade shy of finished.
people.subject: The moment: at a forge trough, he stands with a hammer on his shoulder and one hand on the edge of a steaming water trough, eyes fixed on the rising steam, utterly silent. Face (most important: no eyebrows): a short, round-faced old man; his brow is completely bare and smooth with NO eyebrows at all, only pink shiny skin above the eyes; deep-set small black eyes; a flat wide nose; heavily wrinkled burn-speckled skin with many small pale burn spots across the cheeks and forehead; a grim, closed mouth. Hair: a bald crown with a ring of white stubble. Body: short, thick, stooped; forearms as thick as temple bells, covered in burn marks. Clothing: a thick leather apron over a dark-brown tunic with crossed collar; sleeves cut at the elbow with leather vambraces; no cloak. Hands and objects: a square iron hammer with a face worn mirror-smooth on his shoulder; his other hand rests on a stone trough, steam rising from a blade just visible under the water. Background: blurred stone forge hall, a stream of spring water, white steam. Light: white steam glow and orange coal-light from the lower left; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a silent, rigid face with lowered brows and eyes fixed on the steam, the jaw set and the mouth tight.

people.imagined: On the Hồi Lan road at the head of a halted caravan, one hand lifted to the drivers to stand easy, the sabre still sheathed. He is thinking of his wife's hair and of one day walking the road unarmed.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dusty caravan halt, he lifts one big open hand to calm unseen drivers, looking toward the viewer with slow, patient eyes. Face: a big, broad, gentle-looking face; sun-tanned; a heavy square jaw with a short salt-and-pepper beard; slow warm brown eyes; thick brows; a large straight nose; a quiet half smile. Hair: black with grey, tied in a plain low knot. A plain cord of undyed leather binds the knot and a lock of grey falls over his left temple. Body: very big, broad, tall, thick-armed, the stance of a calm giant, slightly leaning back. He stands with his weight set back on his heels and his big shoulders loose and unhurried. Clothing: a long sand-coloured dust cloak, clean, with a high collar turned back; a dark-brown tunic with crossed collar; leather vambraces; a flat iron-grey sash. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted, palm open; at his left hip a sabre in a plain sheath, its grip NOT touched; on his back, a large round shield faced with grey iron; a bone whistle at the chest. Background: blurred caravan wagons, camels, pale road. Light: warm midday sun from the upper left, a faint ochre earth qi hint. The sun flares behind a cloud of fine yellow dust raised by the camels and makes a pale gold edge on his beard. Expression: a slow, patient gaze with a calm, gentle smile that carries a trace of sadness at the eyes.

people.imagined: Night camp at a lamp's distance from Ô Liệt Phong's escort. She sits alone beside her one lamp with the book on her knee, and has just been given a cup of tea. She is deciding whether to drink it, and then does.
people.subject: The moment: alone at night beside a single lamp, she holds a small steaming tea cup in both hands, looking over its rim into the dark with measured eyes. Face: a thin, narrow, weathered face; high cheekbones; deep-set dark eyes, shadowed; fine straight grey-streaked brows; a long thin nose; thin lips pressed in thought; fine lines like cracked clay. Her temples are sunken and her skin has the dry lines of old pottery. Hair: iron-grey, drawn back flat in a tight bun, a bone pin. Body: very thin, wiry, straight-backed. Clothing: a sand-coloured dust cloak, worn clean, wrapped round her shoulders; dark brown tunic with crossed collar; a plain bone whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: a lit brass lamp with a small round shade set at her feet; a steaming cup in her hands; on her lap, TWO books side by side, one thick and worn, one thin and new, their covers plain. Her fingers are long and bony, curled close around the cup's warmth. A well-made straight double-edged sword, its grip wrapped in ochre silk gone grey with lamp soot, a slim crescent guard of dark iron, a scabbard of dun camel-hide, and a small camel-bell muffled with wool and tied at the scabbard mouth so that it never rings is slung diagonally across the back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Background: blurred night desert, a distant dot of another campfire. Light: warm yellow lamplight from below, cold night blue above; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a measured, weighing look over the cup's rim, the face of a woman who has kept her own counsel for seventy years and is deciding whether to trust a cup of tea.

people.imagined: At the anvil during a pause, he flicks a copper coin and grins at a younger striker, ready to sell him a turn at the big hammer, his black thumbnail catching the light.
people.subject: The moment: at an anvil he holds out his left hand flat toward the viewer with a copper coin held between two fingers and a greedy grin, thumb prominent. Face: a big, broad, ruddy, cheerful face; a thick black moustache; bright small brown eyes; thick brows; a big nose; a wide grin showing a gold-capped tooth. Sweat runs down both temples into the moustache and the soot has left a black mask round the eyes. Hair: black, short and bristly, with a red sweatband. The red sweatband is dark with sweat and a few damp black locks escape from it. Body: huge, barrel-chested, big shoulders. Clothing: a leather smith's apron over a sleeveless dark-brown tunic with a crossed collar; bare muscled arms with leather vambraces; a sand-coloured cloak hung over one shoulder. Hands and objects: the left thumbnail is completely black, crushed, clearly visible and held up toward the camera beside the coin; his right hand rests on the long handle of a big hammer, its head resting on the anvil. Background: blurred forge with a glow, rows of hanging tongs. The coals in the forge glow behind him with a sheet of dancing sparks. Light: orange forge-light from the lower left, a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a friendly, greedy grin with raised brows and a gleam in the eye as he holds out the coin.

people.imagined: He is pumping the bellows in the spring forge, and his whole body is moving with the rhythm. He is asking for nothing. A drop of sweat is on his chin.
people.subject: The moment: at the bellows he leans into a long wooden handle in mid-pump, his body swaying in rhythm, eyes on the coals, a bead of sweat at his chin. Face: a plain, humble, gentle face; sunburnt brown; a long soft jaw; mild dark eyes; thin brows; a short nose; a small calm mouth; smudges of soot on the cheek. His eyebrows are heavy with sooty sweat and his ears stick out a little from the cloth. A fine bead of sweat gathers at his temple. Hair: black, short, damp, with a rag tied round the head. Body: strong, long-armed, lean, bent into the stroke. He leans his whole weight onto the handle with the feet planted wide, the left heel lifted at the top of the stroke. Clothing: a leather apron over a plain brown tunic with a crossed collar; sleeves rolled above the elbow; leather wrist wraps; no cloak, it hangs on a peg beside him. The apron is well cut and dark with years of use, and the leather wrist wraps are scorched but sound. Hands and objects: both hands gripping a long bellows handle; behind him, a rack of hammers. Background: blurred forge with a deep glowing fire in the centre, sparks. A pair of tongs, a dark water barrel and a rack of unfinished blades stand in the shadow beyond the fire. Light: strong orange forge glow from the front left, rim light on the damp hair; a faint steel-grey metal qi hint. Expression: a mild, absorbed, humble calm, the steady face of a man who asks for nothing and keeps the rhythm.

people.imagined: In the sheep shed yard, she grins proudly at the viewer with her mouth wide open to show the gap where a ram knocked out her tooth, like a trophy won.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a yard she grins broadly with her mouth wide open, one forefinger pointing at the gap in her upper front teeth. Face (most important: the missing tooth): a freckled, broad, tanned young face; one upper front tooth is clearly missing, a dark square gap in an otherwise white row, and she is showing it off; bright, bold dark eyes; strong straight brows; a flat nose; a scar on her chin. A thin sheen of sweat is on her nose, and a small crescent scar from an old ram butt is at the right eyebrow. Her cheeks are sunburnt and her bottom lip is cracked from wind. Hair: brown, in a short, thick braid, with a few loose strands. The plait is tied with a strip of red wool and the end is splayed. Body: sturdy, strong shoulders, hands on hips. Clothing: a sand-coloured dust cloak thrown back over her shoulders, clean; a dark-brown tunic with crossed collar; leather vambraces; a sabre on the left hip; a horn whistle. Hands and objects: her right forefinger pointing at her mouth; her left hand on the sabre pommel; a woolly sheep's head just visible behind her. Background: blurred sheep pens, a wooden fence, a pale sky. A few ewes stand in the pen with ears flicked forward. Light: bright daylight from the upper left, a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a proud, bold, sparkling grin with the chin up, a girl daring the viewer to ask how she lost the tooth.

people.imagined: Writing a letter by the last lamp in the long hall at night, ink on her nails. She hears footsteps and slides the page under the other page, then looks up with an innocent face.
people.subject: The moment: at a small desk by a single lamp, she has just slid a half-written letter under a blank sheet and looks up toward the viewer with a too-innocent expression. Face (most important: ink under the nails): a delicate, oval, pale face; large soft dark eyes; fine arched brows; a straight small nose; a gentle half-smile; all her fingernails on the right hand are black with ink and held visibly near the page. Her cheeks are warmed by the lamp and a smudge of ink sits on her chin. Hair: black, long, tied up with a ribbon and a silver pin, a few loose locks. Body: slender, upright, a niece's careful posture. Clothing: a sand-coloured shawl over a finer dark-brown tunic with crossed collar and embroidery-free silk cuffs; a small horn whistle on a thin cord. Hands and objects: a brush in her right hand with inky fingers; two sheets of plain paper with only faint scribbled lines (no readable text); a small brass lamp. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword, its grip wrapped in dark-brown cord, a plain iron ring guard, a scabbard of sand-coloured canvas over wood smudged with ink, and a few strands of undyed thread tucked into the guard, one stained black. Background: blurred dim hall, dark rafters. Dark roof-beams stretch away into shadow and a long row of empty benches runs off beyond the lamp. Light: warm yellow lamplight from the lower left, with shadow beyond; a faint ochre earth qi hint. Expression: a wide-eyed, over-sweet innocence with the mouth just softened into a smile, a girl caught in the act who is too fickle to feel guilty about it.

people.imagined: Slouched against a wagon wheel on guard, a worn shield strap in his hand, content to be bored. He is checking the strap, which has already snapped twice.
people.subject: The moment: sitting against a wagon wheel in the sun, he holds up a worn leather shield strap and studies its fraying edge with a sleepy half-smile. Face: a broad, round, good-natured young face; sun-brown; sleepy brown eyes; soft thick brows; a flat nose; a loose easy mouth. His nose and cheeks are a little peeling from the sun and there is a tiny salt crust at the corner of his mouth. His lower lip is a little chapped and a faint stubble of first whiskers shadows his chin. Hair: black, short, tousled. A tuft of black hair sticks out from beneath a faded cloth that is tied loosely round his head. Body: big for his age, soft-shouldered, sprawling. His belly rests over his belt and his feet are stretched out with the toes pointing sleepily outward. Clothing: a sand-coloured dust cloak, clean, spread on the ground like a blanket; a dark-brown tunic with crossed collar; the cracked heels of his bare feet are visible, pale and salt-cracked; leather vambraces. Hands and objects: a round shield faced with dull iron propped beside him; the fraying shield strap, snapped twice already in his hands; a horn whistle on a cord. Background: blurred wagon, camels, bright sand. A few camels doze with their knees folded under their shadows. Light: bright noon sun from the upper left, a faint ochre earth qi hint. A band of hard shadow from the wagon's edge cuts across his legs and leaves the face in warm light. Expression: a loose, sleepy, good-natured half-smile with the lids low, a loyal boy content to be bored and hoping never to use the shield.

people.imagined: Riding ahead of the watcher at a caravan stop, shouting a long story over his shoulder, a braid of horsehair at his collar flicking. He has never seen the raiders' faces and he is swearing he has.
people.subject: The moment: on horseback at a caravan stop, he twists in the saddle and shouts toward the viewer with one hand cupped to his mouth, mid-story. Face: a thin, lively, tanned face; shifting hazel eyes; quick arched brows; a long mobile mouth wide open in speech; a small moustache. His cheeks are red from shouting, and a thin line of dust has settled into the creases beside his mouth. Hair: black, short, bound with a red headband. Body: wiry, a rider's long legs and short torso. He leans so far over the horse's flank that one boot has almost left the stirrup, as if about to fall into the story. Clothing: a sand-coloured dust cloak whipping behind him; a dark-brown tunic with crossed collar, and at the collar a thick braid of black horsehair clearly visible; leather vambraces; a sabre on the left hip. Hands and objects: a hand cupped to his mouth; the other holds the reins of a brown horse whose mane is partially shown; a horn whistle on a cord. Background: blurred caravan halt, tents, pale dust. Light: bright sun from the upper left, a faint ochre earth qi hint. Sun slants hard across the horse's brown coat and puts a pale rim on his dust cloak. Expression: a wide, shameless grin with bright, wide eyes and a flushed face, shouting happily over his shoulder.

people.imagined: The caravan guard captain in the gorge, holding the line of camels with his sabre drawn, back straight, an old master just before the charge arrives, serene.
people.subject: The moment: in a rocky gorge a veteran guard captain stands with a sabre held ready at his side and glances calmly back over his shoulder toward the viewer; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a long, hard, weathered face; a grey-streaked beard clipped square; steady dark eyes; heavy grey brows; a straight nose; a firm mouth; deep lines. A faint seam of old scar runs through the left eyebrow and fine wrinkles fan from the outer corners of his eyes. Hair: grey-black, in a tight topknot with a plain iron pin. A few white threads show among the grey in his topknot, and the iron pin is plain and dark. Body: tall, lean, upright, spare shoulders. Clothing: a long, plain, sand-coloured travelling cloak over a dark-brown leather jerkin with a crossed collar; leather vambraces; a plain belt with a horn whistle. Hands and objects: a straight sabre in a plain dark sheath at the hip, the right hand on its grip; a coil of rope over his shoulder. Background: faded brown gorge walls and a row of camels in dim haze. Light: soft low light from the upper left, warm and brown. Expression: brave, honest, stubborn; composed. He holds a look of weary calm, as if he already knows what the gorge will cost.
